stem:
Omkar fries puris in hot oil and wants evidence to make sense of the changes he sees.

He considers four possible records:
1  the time each puri takes to puff up
2  the brand name printed on the oil bottle
3  whether each puri puffed up or stayed flat
4  how many times the oil spluttered during frying

Which records could count as evidence of what happened during the experiment?

teacher.key_rationale: Timing, puff-or-flat, and splutter counts are observations from the run. The bottle brand is not evidence of the change during frying. A swaps in brand for a process observation. C keeps brand and drops timing. D treats a yes/no alone as enough.
